title: Cardinality of the deterministic output multiset
statement: For accuracy data with $n>0$, positive numerator, and twice the numerator at most the denominator, the deterministic small-bias output multiset has cardinality $(2^d)^2$, where $d$ is the field degree determined by those data.
hypotheses_covered: Twice the accuracy numerator is at most its denominator
